svg.title: Retry tiers, dead-lettering and replay
svg.desc: Animated sequence. A consumer handler fails on a transient error; the consumer copies the message to <queue>.retry.1 (TTL 1 s), acks the original, and the TTL dead-letters it back to the main queue through the default exchange. The same happens through retry.2 (5 s) and retry.3 (15 s). When retries are exhausted the consumer publishes the message to the dead-letters exchange with diagnostic headers; worker.dead-letters (bound with #) archives it in the dead_letters table. An operator replays it through the worker admin API, which republishes to the original queue. Poison messages skip the retry tiers.
svg.text: packages/messaging consumer · apps/worker dead-letter archive · topology from packages/contracts/src/topology.ts
handler threw → copy attempt=1, ack original
TTL expires → back via default exchange
republish to original queue (default exchange) · REPLAYED

g.text: poison (invalid_message, unhandled_event_type) or NonRetryableError → dead-letters at once
crash loop → quorum x-delivery-limit 10 dead-letters natively
